description: Read one Graunt catalog packet by id. Returns its title, description, price and whether an account is needed, its seller-declared rights, and its public URL. A free packet that needs no account also returns its files: small text files (CSV, JSON, Markdown, text and similar) in the text, and a short-lived download link for each listed file in metadata.files (at most 100 per fetch; files_not_listed counts the rest). A video listing also returns metadata.video: its subjects, measured hours, per-hour price with volume tiers, and the seller's declarations.
name: fetch

ai_generation.description: The seller's AI-generation declaration: extent NONE (not AI-generated), PARTIAL (with share_percent and description) or FULL. A seller declaration, not a Graunt finding; absent when the seller has not declared.

delivery_methods.description: How the files reach a buyer, one row per way: the method and the source the files come from (GRAUNT: storage Graunt holds).

exclusivity.description: Present while the seller offers this listing exclusively and it is on sale. One buyer holds it for the months given; for that Exclusivity Period it is sold to no one else, and the seller licenses it, or any copy, excerpt or edit of it, to no one else for the uses that buyer bought. Buyers who already hold it keep what they bought. Add it by sending exclusive with these months and price_cents when you buy.

holders.description: How many accounts already hold the listing and keep what they bought, by way, with no names. Never the seller, and in a quote never the buyer asking.

own_it_outright.description: Accounts that bought the listing outright.

paying_now.description: Accounts whose payment for the listing is already under way.

subscription.description: Accounts with a subscription to the listing that is still billing.

licenses_elsewhere.description: Licenses of this data outside Graunt, still running, that the seller declares.

mode.description: OPTION: the listing also sells without exclusivity. ONLY: it is sold only exclusively.

months.description: Whole months the buyer holds the listing exclusively, from the sale.

price_cents.description: What exclusivity adds to the listing's own price, in cents, as the seller set it.

files.description: Present when the packet downloads without an account: one entry per listed file (at most 100; files_not_listed counts the rest). inline says how much of the file the text shows (up to 200 KB of text in all); download_url works until download_expires_at.

files_not_listed.description: Present when the packet has more files than one fetch lists (100): how many more there are. They download from the packet's public URL.

files_note.description: Why the files could not be returned right now (for example a rate limit), in plain words.

free_access_grant_url.description: Present only when the packet can be taken with no account: POST it for a short-lived grant, then GET the download_url in its response.

not_on_sale.description: Present with on_sale: why the listing can't be bought now, in a sentence to show a buyer.

on_sale.description: Present, and false, while the listing is held for one buyer: sold to that buyer exclusively, or sharing files with a listing that is. Absent while it is on sale.

permissions.description: The listing's permissions (Marketplace License section 3), in order: code, label, the seller's answer and its label, whether that answer is the License's default (the one AI buyers want), and the License's sentence for it. Rows that do not apply to the listing are left out.

samples.description: What anyone may look at before buying, with the sentence shown beside every sample. files: sample files Graunt holds, each with the API path that answers with a link of at most 5 minutes. detail_fields: the listing detail's other sample fields, by name. Absent when the listing has no samples.

enum: Samples are for evaluating this listing. The license to use the data comes with the purchase.

seller_credentials_summary.description: The seller's credentials (trade licenses, certifications, registrations, memberships) as counts: declared is every credential the seller declares, checked is how many of those an operator checked against a registry, and kinds lists the kinds among them. A seller declaration that Graunt records, never a Graunt finding, a score or a ranking input.

seller_hosted.description: Present only on a listing whose files are delivered from the seller's storage after purchase: file count, bytes, media facts, delivery modes and samples. Never a link to a file.

access_period_days.description: Days the buyer can get the files once they are available; the buyer copies the set within them.

clip_facts.description: Where the set's media facts, its lengths included, come from: GRAUNT_EVERY_FILE when Graunt read every file; SELLER_MANIFEST when they are the seller's manifest, with spec_check saying how many files Graunt read at random against it. LISTING_DECLARED when the seller described the set in place of a file list: the figures are the seller's.

delivery_modes.description: How the buyer can receive the files. LINKS: a download link per file. SEALED: a copy the seller sends, on drives with a tracking number or encrypted over a network.

drives.description: The drives the set ships on, bought at checkout: the drive size, the seller's price per drive with shipping included, and the drives the whole set fills. Null when the set ships none.

media.description: Null when the set holds no audio or video. Frame rates are frames per second; clip lengths are whole seconds.

samples.description: Sample files a buyer can look at before buying.

samples_url.description: The public route that lists the samples.

spec_check.description: Files Graunt read at random from the full set and compared with the manifest's media facts, and how many matched. Null when none were read.

total_duration_seconds.description: Seconds of the set's video clips (files with a length, a width and a height) when it has any; a set with no clips counts every file with a length, its audio. Files with the same SHA-256 count once; a file with no SHA-256 counts as itself.

seller_terms.description: Present only when the seller attached additional terms a buyer accepts before buying: their title, current version, SHA-256 and the URL of their text.

sold_exclusively_until.description: Present on the listing sold exclusively: when its Exclusivity Period ends and it is on sale again. Never the buyer or the price.

video.description: Present only on a video listing: subjects, the hours Graunt measured, the per-hour price with its volume tiers, and the seller's declarations (people on camera, releases, sublicense), kept apart.

barred_uses.description: Uses no license permits for this footage, whatever else the listing allows. Present when the footage shows people.

camera_views.description: How the footage was shot, from the closed camera-view list; empty when none was given. Filter with camera_view on GET /v1/listings.

measured.description: What Graunt measured from the files; null when it measured none.

eligible_duration_seconds.description: Seconds of video a buyer of the whole listing receives and pays for.

hours.description: The same length in hours, rounded to one decimal place, so footage under three minutes reads 0. For an exact amount, use eligible_duration_seconds.

package.description: A paid video listing with measured hours: its one price, and what that comes to per hour. Null on a listing stored with a rate per hour (see per_hour), a free listing, or one with no measured hours.

calculated_price_per_hour_cents.description: price_cents divided by the measured hours, rounded to the cent. A figure for comparing listings; nothing is charged by the hour.

categories.description: Present when some of the listing's categories can be bought at their share of its price. Every category is listed with its measured hours. An order of one or more categories is priced on their combined seconds, the listing price times their share of the measured seconds, rounded down to the cent once; every category together is the whole listing at price_cents. An order under the smallest paid order is refused.

eligible_duration_seconds.description: This category's seconds of video, exact; its price is computed from them.

hours.description: The same length in hours, rounded to one decimal place. For an exact amount, use eligible_duration_seconds.

price_cents.description: This category bought on its own, as checkout prices it. Null when that is under the smallest paid order: the category is then bought only with other categories.
The listing price: what checkout charges for the whole listing before any sales tax.

per_hour.description: Null unless the listing is stored with a rate per hour; a video listing otherwise has one price (see package). On a listing with a rate the price is its measured hours at that rate, less the volume tier the hours in the order reach, applied automatically: there is no code and nothing to request. All amounts are integer cents.

categories.description: Present when the listing can be bought by category: each category's measured hours and its price bought on its own, at the listing's rate with the tier its own hours reach. An order of several categories is priced on their combined hours; every category is the whole listing at price_cents.

eligible_duration_seconds.description: This category's seconds of video, exact; its price is computed from them.

hours.description: The same length in hours, rounded to one decimal place. For an exact amount, use eligible_duration_seconds.

min_hours.description: Hours in the order from which the tier applies.

price_cents.description: The listing price, subtotal_cents minus discount_cents: what checkout charges before any sales tax.

tier_applied.description: The tier this listing's hours reach; null when they reach none.

min_hours.description: Hours in the order from which the tier applies.

volume_tiers.description: This listing's volume schedule, lowest tier first: a term of the listing, recorded in every purchase. The seller funds each discount.

min_hours.description: Hours in the order from which the tier applies.

seller_declared.description: The seller's declarations, kept apart from what Graunt measured. Never Graunt's findings.

attestations.description: What the seller declares about the material, recorded as the seller declared it. Graunt does not compute these.

countries_filmed.description: The countries the footage was filmed in, as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes.

faces_and_plates_blurred.description: Whether the faces and license plates shown are blurred: NONE_SHOWN, BLURRED, PARTLY_BLURRED or NOT_BLURRED.

guardian_releases_on_file.description: Whether the releases on file include a parent's or guardian's release for each minor shown.

identifiable_minors.description: Whether anyone under 18 can be identified in the content.

identifiable_minors_age.description: The age identifiable_minors was answered against: 18. A false identifiable_minors counts only with it.

location_metadata.description: Whether the files' metadata carries GPS or other location data, which reaches the buyer with the files: NONE, PRESENT or NOT_CHECKED.

native_resolution.description: The lowest native resolution in the listing.

people_on_camera.description: How people appear: SUBJECT (the footage is about them) or INCIDENTAL (in passing, in a crowd).

person_release_status.description: Releases from the people shown. INCOMPLETE is allowed only when people appear incidentally.

depicts_person.description: Whether the seller says people appear in the footage.

sublicense.description: ONE_CLIENT_PREAUTHORIZED (every listing created under Marketplace License 2.1, and every older listing whose seller has agreed to it): the buyer may pass the data through to one client, named privately at purchase in sublicense_client, for that client's use within the license; the buyer makes no use of it for itself. The license itself stays non-transferable.

subjects.description: What the footage shows, from the closed video-subject list. Filter with video_subject on GET /v1/listings.

title: Read a Graunt packet
